CLIP (with atom IDs): E12.005 | 00:09.00-00:14.00 | CAM | Low angle on the Mayor framed against the lighthouse beam.
E12.006 | 00:09.40-00:12.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (O.S., cold, venomous) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
[Hard cut]
E11.005 | 00:09.00-00:14.00 | CAM | Close-up on the Mayor's jaw tightening.
E11.006 | 00:09.40-00:12.06 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (cold, pompous) | "The council has already decided her fate."
E11.007 | 00:14.00-00:19.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E11.008 | 00:14.40-00:17.44 | DLG | SELENE (panicked, shrill) | "A lamp-keeper's girl in my mother's lace? Never!"
E11.009 | 00:19.00-00:23.00 | CAM | Close-up on Selene's hands gripping the rail.
E11.010 | 00:19.20-00:23.00 | ACT | Selene kneels on the slick quay boards.
E11.011 | 00:19.40-00:22.06 | DLG | SELENE (shrill, cruel) | "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
E11.012 | 00:23.00-00:29.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Selene and Tobin, the space between them charged.
E11.013 | 00:23.40-00:26.82 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (O.S., urgent, gruff) | "I saw who slipped the ring into your shawl."
E11.014 | 00:29.00-00:34.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E11.015 | 00:29.40-00:32.06 | DLG | SELENE (shrill, mocking) | "Mother will see you hang for this."
E11.016 | 00:34.00-00:38.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Tobin and Mara, the space between them charged.
E11.017 | 00:34.20-00:38.00 | ACT | Tobin slaps the cup from Mara's hand and it shatters.
E11.018 | 00:34.40-00:37.06 | DLG | SELENE (panicked, shrill) | "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
E11.019 | 00:38.00-00:42.00 | CAM | Close-up on Corin's jaw tightening.
E11.020 | 00:38.40-00:40.30 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (pompous, triumphant) | "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
